title: PROPOSED criteria gap verdict
description: Design-only verdict transcribed from the DK-500e-1 delivers_to contract {status: gap|no_gap|not_judged, missing_concerns: [string], reason: string|null} (docs/acceptance-criteria/decision-kernel/DK-500-reusable-decision-criteria/DK-500e-1.yaml). The missing concerns are concerns from a finite list fixed before the judgement, copied verbatim; Jev never writes concern text. No kernel step, payload or validator implements this verdict yet; the verdict is evidence, never approval.

status.description: gap: a concern is missing; no_gap: nothing is missing; not_judged: the judgement was not made (never shown as no_gap)

missing_concerns.description: the concerns no reused criterion covers, verbatim from the fixed concern list

reason.description: why the gap was not judged; DK-500e-1 and DK-500e-1-i name no_concerns_listed, budget and jev_unavailable
